expected_behavior: Triage makes no tool calls, reads no source files and runs no commands; it only talks with the user and writes the brief.
Every question is asked as a panel, never buried in a paragraph.
The bug is classified by platform, type and reproduction status, with the type taken from the symptoms the user reports.
The brief is written to <run folder>/E<nn>-triage.md for the debugging skills to start from.
